tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Connect this conversation to a Dreambooth Studio account. Returns a link the person opens in their own browser, where they sign in to Dreambooth with an email and password or with Google, and approve. Works for people who do NOT have a Dreambooth account yet — approving creates one, with a 14-day Pr

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Whether this conversation currently has a Dreambooth account connected, and which one. Call this if you are unsure whether to run connect_account first. Cheap and read-only — it does not contact Dreambooth.

tools.name: get_sessions
tools.description: List the photo sessions recorded on this operator's booths, with totals. tools.name: get_gallery_stats
tools.description: How much media this operator's booths have produced: total, still active, and expired past the retention window. Call this when the operator asks how many photos or videos a booth has taken, or whether media is being lost to retention. Returns counts only, not the media itself.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Dreambooth Studio documentation and FAQ. Call this before answering any question about the product, pricing, packages, hardware, printing, subscriptions, or troubleshooting — answer from the docs rather than from memory. Works without a connected account.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the photobooth projects this operator owns, with id, name, public link slug, whether it is active, and its currency. Call this first whenever the operator names a booth — you need the project id to filter any other tool by booth. Does not return booth designs or page layouts.

tools.description: Full detail for a single booth: its name, public link, currency, screen size, and the live status of the device running it — whether it is online, when it was last seen, app version, and camera/printer/internet state. tools.description: This operator's remaining AI credit balance and their current subscription plan, including when it ends. Call this when they ask how many credits are left, whether they can still run AI effects, or what plan they are on. Credits are separate from wallet money — do not confuse the two.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_account, start_frame, save_frame, preview_filter, start_booth · Private data: connect_account, connection_status, get_revenue_summary, get_credits, get_wallet_transactions, save_frame · Public sink: connect_account, create_filter · Destructive: connection_status, get_credits, create_filter, duplicate_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_account, start_frame, save_frame, preview_filter, start_booth · Private data: connect_account, connection_status, get_revenue_summary, get_credits, get_wallet_transactions, save_frame · Public sink: connect_account, create_filter · Destructive: connection_status, get_credits, create_filter, duplicate_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "connect_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Connect this conversation to a Dreambooth Studio account. Returns a link the person opens in their own browser, where they sign in to Dreambooth with an email and password or with Google, and approve. Works for people who do NOT have a Dreambooth account yet — approving creates one, with a 14-day Pr" → after: "Connect this conversation to the person's Dreambooth Studio account. The answer's status says what happened. already_connected: an account is connected; nothing to do. awaiting_approval: it returns a link the person opens in their own browser to sign in with Google and approve. A Google account with"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
